items.stem: When is C++ generally preferred over Blueprint in Unreal?

options.text: For performance-critical or complex core systems, while Blueprint suits rapid iteration and designer-facing logic
options.rationale: Correct: a common split is core in C++, iteration in Blueprint.

options.text: C++ is always required; Blueprint cannot ship games
options.rationale: False; many games ship heavy Blueprint use.

options.text: Blueprint is always faster than C++
options.rationale: Generally C++ is faster for hot paths.

options.text: They cannot be used in the same project

items.explanation: Correct: a common split is core in C++, iteration in Blueprint.
